book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte

title: Types of garden
competency: Describe vegetable gardens and container gardens.

keywords.def: A garden where vegetables are grown, in the ground or in a planting bed.
Plants grown in containers deep enough for their roots.

en.text: The two most popular types of gardening are vegetable gardens and container gardens. A vegetable garden is in the ground or in a bed. A container garden uses pots, bottles or barrels deep enough for the roots, and needs watering more often.

screens.title: No land?
screens.ask: You live in a flat in Addis Ababa with no land. Can you still grow vegetables?
opts: No, you need a big farm
screens.after: Yes. Many vegetables grow well in containers like pots, bottles and barrels.

screens.title: 3.1.2 Types of garden
paras: There are many types of gardening.
The two most popular are vegetable gardens and container gardens.

screens.title: a. Vegetable garden
paras: A vegetable garden is a garden where vegetables are grown.
You select a site, plan, prepare the soil and choose seeds.
Then you plant and care for the plants until harvest.
The result is fresh food, like cabbage, carrots and potatoes, to eat, share or sell.
screens.note: A vegetable garden can be in the ground or in a planting bed. It does not need much money, time or talent.

screens.title: b. Container garden
paras: Many vegetables grow in containers deep enough for their roots.
The bigger the container, the easier it is to succeed.
Containers need more frequent irrigation than gardens.
They can be made from used bottles, pots and barrels.

screens.title: Gardens around us
paras: Farmers grow cabbage, tomato, potato, lemon and avocado around their homes.
Urban families grow vegetables and flowers in their compounds.
Schools make vegetable and flower gardens with teachers and students.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A garden where vegetables are grown, in the ground or in a bed.
Plants grown in containers deep enough for their roots.

screens.text: The two most popular types of gardening are:
screens.why: The book names vegetable gardens and container gardens.

screens.text: Containers need less water than gardens in the ground.
screens.why: Containers need more frequent irrigation, especially as plants grow.
screens.clue: Does a small pot dry out fast or slowly?

screens.text: Which of these can be made into a container garden?
screens.why: Bottles, barrels and pots can hold soil. A spade and a rake are tools.

screens.ask: Almaz grows lettuce in a pot. The bigger the ___, the easier it is to succeed.
screens.why: The book says the bigger the container, the easier it is.

screens.text: Tigist has a small balcony and little time to fetch water. Which plan fits best?
opts: Large containers with a drip irrigation system
Tiny cups with no water plan
screens.ans: Large containers with a drip irrigation system
screens.why: A balcony has no ground, so containers fit. Big containers are easier, and drip irrigation helps because containers need frequent water.
screens.clue: Think about space, container size and water.

test.text: Where is a vegetable garden made?
opts: In the ground or a planting bed
test.ans: In the ground or a planting bed
test.why: The book says ground or bed.

test.text: Many vegetables can grow in containers.
Why do containers need more irrigation?
opts: They hold less soil and dry out
Plants in pots do not drink
test.ans: They hold less soil and dry out

test.text: Vegetable gardening needs a lot of money and talent.
test.why: The book says it does not take a lot of money, time or talent.

test.text: A school wants a garden but its ground is concrete. What is best?
test.why: Containers do not need open ground.
